name: explainroo
description: The video studio your AI agent runs. Free on your own computer, with no account and no key.

interface.shortDescription: Make narrated videos on your own computer
interface.longDescription: Your agent writes the words and the pictures. A voice model on your computer reads the script, Chrome draws the frames, and you get an MP4.
defaultPrompt: Make a 60 second explainer video about how DNS works.
